title: A pharmacy shall effectuate a recall of medication that is or may be defective
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.19(12), a pharmacy shall effectuate a recall of medication that is or may be defective in any way.
exam_relevance: Tests the Massachusetts duty, binding on the pharmacy, to carry out a recall of medication that is or may be defective, which reaches possible as well as confirmed defects.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The duty reaches medication that may be defective, not only medication confirmed defective.
The paragraph does not itself define a recall or state the steps a pharmacy takes to effectuate one.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
